programmes.entry_requirements: M1: bachelor-level degree equivalent in computer science, mathematics, physics or mechanics (35 places). M2: M1 CHPS (automatic admission for UVSQ M1 CHPS), or a scientific M1 / engineering school with parallel computing (architecture, algorithms, programming) and applied mathematics; selection on file otherwise.
programmes.structure_summary: Part of the national network of CHPS masters. The M1 mixes mathematics (numerical analysis, modelling) with HPC (parallel architectures, parallel programming, distributed algorithms, software engineering for HPC and AI). The M2 has a common core (multicore programming, hardware accelerators, performance evaluation, numerical programming, data/learning, continuum mechanics) followed by one of two tracks: IHPS (high-performance computing, compilers, code optimisation, quantum computing) or MSCHP (modelling and simulation, PDE discretisation, domain decomposition, model reduction). Strongly project-oriented, ending with a 5-6 month internship.

Engineering degree includes three internships totalling 12 months.

programmes.structure_summary: Engineering degree in computer science and telecoms with a 'HPC et Big Data' parcours. S7 and S8 give the foundations (functional programming, concurrent systems and middleware, optimisation and operations research, OpenMP, advanced linear algebra with Krylov and sparse methods, PDE, numerical simulation project). S9 has five UE: distributed systems and security (including a Calcul Parallèle unit with MPI and an introduction to GPU programming), advanced statistical machine learning, High Performance Scientific Computing (parallel numerical algorithms and performance analysis), inverse problems, and an elective UE (cloud and big-data infrastructure, cloud strategy, quantum mechanics for computing, etc.). ecosystem.name: IDRIS (CNRS) - Jean Zay supercomputer, GENCI national resource
ecosystem.why_relevant: Real national GPU supercomputer (CPU, V100, A100 and H100 partitions) operated with Slurm, a Lustre parallel file system and InfiniBand/Omni-Path networks: the closest public, documented example of the cluster stack a compute infrastructure engineer runs. The hardware, scheduler and filesystem pages are public documentation to read and reproduce in labs.

evidence.claim: Jean Zay runs RedHat and Slurm
evidence.quote: L'environnement d'exploitation se base sur RedHat 9.6 (depuis le 17/02/2026) et Slurm 23.11.3 (depuis le 01/10/2024)

evidence.claim: All nodes access a parallel Lustre file system
evidence.quote: L'ensemble des nœuds accède à un système de fichiers parallèle Lustre à très forte bande passante

evidence.claim: Two interconnect generations: Omni-Path on HPE SGI 8600 nodes, InfiniBand on the BullSequana XH3000 extension
evidence.quote: sont interconnectés par un réseau Intel Omni-Path et ceux de l'extension Bull BullSequana XH3000 sont interconnectés par un réseau Infiniband

evidence.claim: H100 partition: 364 quad-GPU nodes (extension July 2024)
evidence.quote: Avec la partition gpu_p6 (extension juillet 2024), vous aurez accès aux ressources suivantes

ecosystem.name: IDRIS training catalogue (HPC and AI courses: MPI, OpenMP, GPU directives, Kokkos, Deep Learning Optimisé sur Jean Zay)
ecosystem.why_relevant: Short, free (for CNRS and university staff) or CNRS-Formation-Entreprise courses taught by the Jean Zay support team, including a multi-GPU deep-learning scaling course; the course pages are public syllabi that fit a self-study path in parallel programming and distributed training. Registration site was under maintenance on the page read, so check dates.

evidence.claim: IDRIS offers HPC and AI training
evidence.quote: L'IDRIS propose des formations en calcul haute performance (HPC) et en intelligence artificielle (IA)

evidence.claim: Courses are free for CNRS and university staff, open to company staff via CNRS Formation Entreprise
evidence.quote: Ces formations sont gratuites pour le personnel du CNRS et des universités

evidence.claim: DLO-JZ course covers scaling deep learning on a supercomputer and multi-GPU distribution
evidence.quote: distribution sur plusieurs GPU seront abordées, d'un point de vue système et algorithmique

ecosystem.name: Réseau des Masters CHPS (Calcul Haute Performance, Simulation)
ecosystem.why_relevant: National network of French state-recognised HPC and simulation degrees (Paris-Saclay, Bordeaux CISD, Toulouse ENSEEIHT, Perpignan, Reims) with joint seminars, shared internship offers and a student hackathon with Teratec; the entry point to compare French HPC curricula.

evidence.quote: Parcours CISD, ENSEIRB-MATMECA, Université de Bordeaux

evidence.claim: Toulouse ENSEEIHT is listed as a member (spelled ENSEEITH on the page)
evidence.quote: Parcours CHPS, ENSEEITH (Toulouse)

evidence.claim: Teratec hackathon for HPC students with participation of network groups
evidence.quote: Teratec organise en 2024 un Hackathon à destination des étudiants sensibilisés aux thématiques du HPC
